data.title: 黄泉 · 天亮之前
data.description: 清晨的微光透过窗帘，黄泉穿着长衫靠在床头，手边的薄毯还未收起。她安静地看着天色变亮。
data.promptProse: Resting against an ornate wooden headboard in a quiet hotel suite before dawn, Acheron pulls a soft knit blanket across her lap as the first gentle lavender rays of sunrise filter through parted drapes. Soft morning light touches her violet hair and calm expression, with distant city lights fading into morning mist through the wide window.
data.animaCaption: She watches the first light through the curtains.
